measurement_convention: Metres from level ground to withers, never ear tips. Hands are base-4 inches: 15.2 hh = 62 in, not 15.2 decimal hands.
design_scope: Conformation directions are informed by cited primary standards; numeric sculpt multipliers and model targets are original game art choices, not measured breed averages or registration criteria. Coat color is separate from mesh identity.

sculpt_convention.reference: A corrected neutral riding-horse mesh normalized to common withers height. Apply regional deformation and update rest skeleton, then set final height exactly once.
sculpt_convention.multipliers: First eleven sculpt values are ratios of regional dimensions to neutral normalized reference; global scaling alone is insufficient. Adjust landmarks and attachments together.
sculpt_convention.face_profile: Signed displacement normal to straight nasal profile, fraction of withers height; negative = mild dish, positive = mild convexity. Preserve airway volume and muzzle alignment.
sculpt_convention.neck_arch: Crest bow above straight neck centerline, fraction of withers height; carriage must also be set through neck base/poll landmarks.
sculpt_convention.rider: Existing BREEDS3 size multipliers are legacy. Do not multiply calibrated absolute mesh height again. Rider/tack/camera anchors must follow actual saddle, poll and back landmarks.
